content.text:
I found one problem on the products page and fixed it. The "Add to cart" buttons had white text on a white background, so they looked like empty boxes.

The cause was in `site/css/components.css`. `.btn-secondary` set its text color to `var(--color-surface)`, which is the same white as its background. I changed it to `var(--color-ink)`. The same class is used on any other page with a secondary button, so those get the fix too.

The 16 functional tests pass. I didn't look at the page in a browser, and the tests don't check styling. I also read through the chips, badges, thumbnails and bundle styles and saw nothing else wrong. If something still looks off, tell me what you're seeing.

I haven't committed the change.

STATUS: DONE
